refinement_basis: EXP-OBL-014 observed before outcomes that recovery=True for 392/399 events, collapsing two four-class cells to 3 and 4; low support remained a 267/132 structural split with 76.19% fixed-neighbor agreement.
scientific_change: Remove only the structurally redundant recovery assignment axis. Preserve the exact canonical anchor, volume coordinate, low-support primary, close-support neighbor, timing, and outcome prohibition.
question: Does V1's canonical minimum-volume session define reproducible neutral support-held versus support-broken lineages before outcomes are inspected?
mechanism: The lowest-volume session in t-30..t-1 is a strategy-native supply-dry-up anchor. Whether its adjusted low remains defended through t-1 is an objective distinction between retained and failed support formation.

population.qualification: Accepted completed V1 entries, bounded PIT-B; only identity columns may be projected from the accepted-cycle table.

canonical_anchor.volume_coordinate: canonical signal-time coordinate; visible valid share multipliers rebase only earlier historical volumes; null optional rights coalesce to zero
canonical_anchor.minimum_tie_rule: earliest exactly tied minimum, matching canonical Python min behavior
canonical_anchor.canonical_admission: minimum-volume close location <=0.50 and minimum/mean volume <=0.70

primary_lineages.L_SUPPORT_HELD: every later adjusted low is greater than or equal to the canonical minimum-volume session adjusted low
primary_lineages.L_SUPPORT_BROKEN: at least one later adjusted low is below the canonical minimum-volume session adjusted low
primary_lineages.boundary: exact equality; no selected distance threshold

fixed_neighbor.L_SUPPORT_HELD: every later adjusted close is greater than or equal to the anchor adjusted close
fixed_neighbor.L_SUPPORT_BROKEN: at least one later adjusted close is below the anchor adjusted close

decision.FREEZE_LINEAGE: all 399 anchors reconcile, both neutral lineages satisfy size/year gates, low/close support agreement reaches 65%, and no outcome enters
decision.REJECT_BEFORE_OUTCOME: canonical reconciliation, coverage, balance, temporal presence, neighbor stability, PIT, or outcome prohibition fails

outcome_prohibition: holding duration, holding path, or exit
winner, loser, severe-loss, or right-tail class
reintroducing or promoting the collapsed recovery axis

interpretation_boundary.if_frozen: A freeze authorizes only a separate preregistered outcome reveal.
forbidden: minimum-volume age or distance threshold search
choosing low or close support after construction
entry, exit, sizing, overlay, or production rule
